description: Synthetic 3-band linear mixtures; no imagery or Google data

independent_reference.method: Each clean column is the explicit product M*a. For the last sample, M^-1 is given by its adjugate divided by det(M)=9/25; multiplying it by noise [1/100,-2/100,1/100] gives the listed exact abundance delta. This is an exact rational reference independent of QR, LU, SVD, and NumPy solver implementations.
